scope: LOCAL SYNTHETIC MEASUREMENT ONLY — not Cloudflare, D1, Supabase or production capacity

method.database: Node DatabaseSync SQLite in memory through a D1-shaped adapter
method.http: In-process Request/Response; no sockets or external HTTP
method.identity: Synthetic Supabase user verifier; no remote provider latency
method.cache: Warm process; no Cloudflare cache or geographic distribution
method.concurrency: Interleaved Promise.all save pairs on one serial SQLite connection
method.timing: performance.now wall time including JSON parsing and mock identity
method.readMetric: SQL rows returned; not rows scanned or D1 billed rows

WITH post_page AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT p.* FROM community_posts p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.context = ? ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT ? ), reaction_totals AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.post_id, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reaction='like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS likes, SUM(CASE WHEN r.reaction='upvote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, MAX(CASE WHEN r.user_id=? AND r.reaction='like' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS liked, MAX(CASE WHEN r.user_id=? AND r.reaction='upvote' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvoted FROM community_reactions r WHERE r.post_id IN (SELECT id FROM post_page) GROUP BY r.post_id ), comment_totals AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.context,COUNT(*) AS comments FROM community_comments c WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.context IN (SELECT 'post:' || id FROM post_page) GROUP BY c.context ) SELECT p.*,u.alias,COALESCE(r.likes,0) AS likes,COALESCE(r.upvotes,0) AS upvotes, COALESCE(c.comments,0) AS comments,COALESCE(r.liked,0) AS liked,COALESCE(r.upvoted,0) AS upvoted FROM post_page p JOIN community_users u ON u.id=p.user_id LEFT JOIN reaction_totals r ON r.post_id=p.id LEFT JOIN comment_totals c ON c.context='post:' || p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC
queryPlan: SEARCH p USING INDEX community_posts_context (context=? AND deleted_at=?)
SEARCH r USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_community_reactions_1 (post_id=?)
SEARCH c USING COVERING INDEX community_comments_context (context=? AND deleted_at=?)
SEARCH r USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (post_id=?) LEFT-JOIN
SEARCH c USING AUTOMATIC COVERING INDEX (context=?) LEFT-JOIN

limits: Local SQLite, CPU, memory, storage and identity mocks do not model Cloudflare queues, D1 limits, network round trips, Supabase RLS or connection pooling.
These observations cannot establish a supported number of concurrent students or requests per second.
Use a separately authorized staging deployment, real backend telemetry and a graduated load test before publishing a production capacity target.
